summary: Minimal 2-line fix correctly extends set_output propagation to the remainder estimator, mirroring the existing per-transformer handling and resolving the reported dtype/column-loss bug for the common pre-fit set_output usage pattern.

issues.description: Only self.remainder (unfitted param) is updated; if set_output is called after fit, the already-fitted self.remainder_ clone used for future transform calls isn't touched. This mirrors an existing limitation for regular sub-transformers in the same method, so it's not a regression introduced by this PR.
